How many contacts the last `PhysicsUpdate` of a world found between bodies that report them (see `PhysicsContactReport`). The list is the same on every run, in the order of the bodies, one contact for each pair.

```blitzbasic
PhysicsUpdate
For i = 0 To GetPhysicsContactCount() - 1
	Print GetPhysicsContactEntityA(i) + " touches " + GetPhysicsContactEntityB(i)
Next
```
@param world The physics world, 0 (default) for the default world.
@returns The number of contacts.
@gap The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
